Plain-text compatibility output for an unassociated or unsupported report names the client issue and non-supported reason code on that single "Compatibility (...)" line (such as "issue capability-association-mismatch; non-supported: binding-missing"), while detailed compatibility output prints the full pretty-printed compatibility JSON and compact client advice JSON.

A non-blocking warning from the PDD interpreter (such as "needs-hash-tool" on "prompts/place_order.prompt.md") prints under "Lint advisories (from the PDD interpreter):" with no "Lint problems" heading.

Blocking lint findings print under "Lint problems (from the PDD interpreter):" (or "Local lint problems:" in local mode) ahead of any "Lint advisories (from the PDD interpreter):" (or "Local lint advisories:") section when blocking findings and warnings appear together.
